init_nerf_model: build a Keras NeRF model with configurable depth, width, skip connections, and view direction support
get_embedder: create a positional encoding embedder with configurable frequency bands for 3D input coordinates
get_rays: compute ray origins and directions from a pinhole camera using height, width, focal length, and camera-to-world matrix
ndc_rays: convert ray origins and directions to normalized device coordinates for a given camera and near plane
sample_pdf: perform hierarchical PDF sampling from bins and weights for importance sampling along rays
